name: Egypt
note: Signature dishes from TheMealDB, whose photography is shot to one uniform format. Attribution: TheMealDB (themealdb.com).

dishes.name: Ful Medames
dishes.description: Ful medames, or simply ful, is a stew of cooked fava beans served with olive oil, cumin, and optionally with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, chili pepper and other vegetables, herbs, and spices.

dishes.name: Koshari
dishes.description: Koshary, Kushari or Koshari is Egypt's national dish and a widely popular street food.

dishes.name: Mulukhiyah
dishes.description: Mulukhiyah (Arabic: مُلُوخِيَّة, romanized: mulūḫiyya), also known as mulukhiyya, molokhiyya, melokhiyya, molohiya or ewédú, is a type of jute plant whose leaves are used to prepare a traditional Egyptian and Arab dish.

dishes.name: Shakshuka
dishes.description: Shakshouka is a Maghrebi dish of eggs poached in a sauce of tomatoes, olive oil, peppers, onion, and garlic, commonly spiced with cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper.

dishes.name: Shawarma
dishes.description: Shawarma (; Arabic: شاورما) is a popular street food in the Middle East that originated in the Levant during the Ottoman Empire.
